reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead 0nl — real adoptedStyleSheets path and node preservation)

spec_match.rationale: Implements a genuine adoptedStyleSheets path where shadow roots adopt constructable CSSStyleSheets directly, swapping themes without destroying internal DOM nodes. Declarative module scripts in head are accurately reflected and supported by live telemetry.

interactive.rationale: Three theme buttons (Default, Dark, Warm) switch adoptedStyleSheets live across three components, with aria-pressed state, telemetry updates, and live style reflection.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Concept lede matches the feature-index promise on key terms (components, shadow, specifier, style, adoptedStyleSheets).

edge_cases.rationale: Provides a labelled simulation fallback when adoptedStyleSheets or constructable stylesheets are absent, and verifies original node connectivity throughout theme changes.

references.rationale: Dedicated references section linking ChromeStatus, WHATWG HTML PR #11687, and CSSOM adoptedStyleSheets.

design_system.rationale: Buttons pair background and color on hover, high contrast WCAG AAA tokens throughout, and table cells wrapped cleanly.

accessibility.rationale: All interactive buttons meet 44px min-height tap targets, aria-pressed states, visible focus outlines, and status changes are announced via aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified in Chrome DevTools MCP on mobile 360x740 DPR3 (0px overflow) and desktop 1280x800.

summary: shadow-dom-theming updated (bead 0nl): replaced unconditional shadowRoot.innerHTML rewrites with a genuine adoptedStyleSheets path where constructable stylesheets are swapped dynamically while preserving original DOM nodes, added live shadow DOM telemetry, added dedicated references section, and verified 0px mobile overflow at 360px viewport.

guidanceConsulted.query: shadowRoot adoptedStyleSheets dynamic theme switching without DOM re-render
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets with constructable CSSStyleSheet instances to change component styles without touching or destroying internal DOM nodes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Created constructable sheets once and swapped adoptedStyleSheets directly; internal p nodes are created in connectedCallback and remain connected across theme switches.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DevTools MCP evaluation confirmed shadow.adoptedStyleSheets.length === 1 and node.isConnected === true across theme changes.
